about_the_game:
Challenge friends to compete for the title of Island master! Battle it out in teams in this chaotic party fiesta on tropical islands and the open seas. Play as the Raccoon Rascals or the Puckis Pandas in vibrant and stylized 3D environments.

Tailwind Tropics is a stylized, 3D,  round-based team party game where you collect, construct and combat each other in order to claim the title of “Island Masters”! Scour the tropical islands in search of materials to use in construction of your team's battleship and then duke it out on the open seas! You battle for the sake of battle and play against friends, enemies and frenemies. Tailwind tropics is a true showcase of the long standing feud between the Puckish Pandas and Raccoon Rascals and their crazy competitions.

  • Collect materials by harvesting, mining and woodcutting resources or by stealing from the enemy team!

  • Craft parts for your battleship to prepare for battle by using your team's resources. And once again, steal if necessary!

  • Combat the enemy team in battleships and outlive or destroy the enemy to win the round!

  • Clutch by winning a round even if you lost the first one! A short match is still the best of three.

  • Express yourself with cute hats and cosmetics! while you enjoy the vibrant environment and tropical setting the islands have to offer!

  • Enjoy music composed by Gabriel Ekberg for those amazing island vibes!

  • Challenge your friends and family and play with balancing enabled for a more fair challenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
